title: Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 187
summary: Loneliness is carried here from gauree, Fifth Mehla: toward my honor and glory are Yours, God.
whyItMatters: This shabad is useful when life feels alone, unseen, disconnected, because it keeps loneliness inside remembrance, conduct, and the Creator's larger care instead of private mood.
takeaway: Loneliness steadies when my honor and glory are Yours, God.

lines.translation: Whatever my Friend does, I accept.
My Friend's actions are pleasing to me. ||1||
Within my conscious mind, the One Lord is my only Support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੁ ਹਮਰਾ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis kichh karanaa su hamaraa meet ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: One who does this is my Friend. ||1||Pause||
By Guru's Grace, I give my love to Him. ||2||
My Friend is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
He is the All-powerful Being, the Supreme Lord and Master. ||3||
I am Your servant; You are my Lord and Master.
Nanak: my honor and glory are Yours, God. ||4||40||109||

structure: The opening movement names the pressure directly: gauree, Fifth Mehla:.
The middle movement deepens the correction by holding the mind inside my Friend is Carefree.
The closing movement leaves a return you can actually keep: my honor and glory are Yours, God.
